item.title: Graphviz Toolkit: Drawing with DOT
item.description: 1. Introduction Graphviz is an open-source drawing toolkit developed at Bell Labs. It uses a specific DSL (domain-specific language), DOT, as its scripting language. It uses layout engines to parse DOT scripts and complete automatic layout. It supports a rich set of export formats, such as PNG, JPG, PostScript, SVG,
